# Pip palette colour report (generated by design-lab/analysis/colorLab.mjs)

Status: MEASURED (computed, not tested on people). CVD = Machado 2009 severity 1.0 in linear sRGB; distance = CIE dE2000 after simulation. Rule of thumb (read from the literature, a guess for this UI): dE2000 under 5 is hard to tell apart, 5-10 distinguishable with effort, over 10 clearly distinct. Wrong if: a real colour-vision user separates a pair we rate under 5 easily (pip position/count also disambiguates, since a half shows N pips), or confuses one we rate above 10.
